# mailchannels_sub_account_limit (Resource)

The monthly send limit of a sub-account. Destroying it removes the limit, so the sub-account shares the parent account's remaining capacity again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailchannels_sub_account" "staging" {
  handle       = "examplestaging"
  company_name = "Example Inc. (staging)"
}

resource "mailchannels_sub_account_limit" "staging" {
  handle = mailchannels_sub_account.staging.handle
  sends  = 10000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Handle of the sub-account.
- `sends` (Number) Messages the sub-account may send per month, 0 or more.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The sub-account handle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Sub-account limits are imported by the sub-account handle.
terraform import mailchannels_sub_account_limit.staging examplestaging
```
